descriptions.value: Maximum extent under Esarhaddon and Ashurbanipal, as a MultiPolygon: the Near Eastern core plus a separate Nile-valley lobe for the occupation of Egypt (-671..-663). Egypt was held briefly and through client rulers; the two parts were never contiguous on the ground across Sinai in any administrative sense.
